author: Linnaeus, 1758

points.en: dark rich brown head and face
white underparts with dark scaly markings

art.subject: Scaly-breasted Munia (Lonchura punctulata), adult (sexes alike) in Korean grassland in autumn: face, chin and throat rich chocolate-brown; crown, nape, back and wings warm brown with faint pale shaft streaks; rump and tail dull olive-brown; breast, flanks and belly white, each feather edged dark brown, giving a dense pattern of dark scales or crescents; only the lower belly centre and vent are plainer whitish. Bill very deep, conical, dark slate-grey; eye dark; legs grey.
art.pose: clinging to a seeding grass stem, side view
art.scene: grassy embankment with seeding grasses beside harvested rice fields in Korea in autumn (October), warm light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult (sexes alike), clinging to a seeding grass stem, side view: tiny plump finch with a large rounded head, dark rich brown head and face, very thick stubby dark bill, brown back and wings, short tail, white underparts covered in dark scaly markings
adult, perched on a grass stem, three-quarter front view: dark brown face and throat, very thick dark bill, white breast, flanks and belly covered in dark scales, short tail
art.build: Tiny, plump finch, clearly smaller than a sparrow, with a large rounded head, short neck and short tail; clings to grass stems and feeds on seeds in small flocks. Bill very deep and conical, almost as deep as it is long, much shorter than the head, dark slate-grey. Legs short, grey. Wings short and rounded, the wingtips reaching only the base of the tail. Tail short and slightly graduated, plain, without white.
avoid: Do not paint wing bars, streaks on the underparts or white in the tail; the only bold pattern is the scaly breast, flanks and belly.
Do not paint a pale, pink or red bill; the bill is dark slate-grey.
Do not paint a white rump or a black head (White-rumped Munia, Chestnut Munia).
Do not paint plain buff underparts on an adult; that is the juvenile.
